data.segment_description:
(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Tonight's vice presidential debate between Senator Joe Biden and Governor Sarah Palin previewed; scenes shown of both arriving in St. Louis.  

(Denver: Dean Reynolds)  The importance of tonight's debate featured; CBS News poll findings on the voters' view of Palin over the last month after her high-stakes interviews.  [Senator John McCAIN&nbsp- mentions Palin.]  [On Tuesday, for the "Des Moines Register," McCAIN&nbsp- comments on the "Georgetown cocktail party person" who doesn't like her.]  The McCain campaign's pulling of staff from Michigan noted.  

(Lansing, Michigan: Chip Reid)  The strategy from Senator Barack Obama's campaign for Biden in the debates examined; scenes shown from the campaign trail and an Internet ad; CBS News poll findings that voters expect Biden to win the debate cited.  [Obama campaign manager David PLOUFFE†- calls Palin a "best debater."]  

(St. Louis: Katie Couric, Bob Schieffer)  What Palin needs to do tonight to reassure the voters after her first impression and her difficult interviews and what Biden needs to NOT do tonight: go after McCain and not Palin discussed.  

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  The vice presidential questions to be aired later previewed.

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  The status of the bailout plan that will be up for a vote in the House tomorrow updated; details given about its growing size and price tag.  

(Washington: Wyatt Andrews)  The Senate's new huge bill examined; details given about the additions to the House bill, including a lot of tax breaks, extra funding for rural schools and the question of opposition to the legislation from fiscal conservatives.  [President BUSH&nbsp- says the House needs to pass this.]  [Representatives James CLYBURN†, Zach WAMP, Pete HOEKSTRA&nbsp- offer views on the bill.]

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.   (San Carlos, California: John Blackstone)  Confirmation in California that worldwide adventurer Steve Fossett's plane and human remains have been found in the mountains a year after he vanished featured; scenes of the mountains in the distance, parts of the plane and identification cards and money found by a hiker.  [Madera County Sheriff John ANDERSON†, acting NTSB chairman Mark ROSENKER†- comment on the severity of the head-on crash.]  [Hiker Preston MORROW†- comments on his discovery.]  Fossett's aviation records recalled.

data.segment_description:
(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  The views of vice presidential candidates Senator Joe Biden and Governor Sarah Palin on the question of character and leadership with specific questions on their favorite vice president, on the best and worse thing Vice President Dick Cheney has done and on their favorite movie.  [PALIN - talks about vice presidential candidates Geraldine Ferraro and Vice President/President George Bush.]  [BIDEN - speaks about Vice President/President Lyndon Johnson and his own role as implementing Senator Barack Obama's policies; states he admires Cheney's strength, but he does not trust the American people and has done more harm in terms of shredding the Constitution.]  [PALIN - calls the duck hunting accident the worst thing Cheney did; praises his support of the troops serving in our military.]  [BIDEN - explains why "Chariots of Fire" is his favorite movie; describes his favorite scenes.]  [PALIN - explains why sports movies like "Hoosiers" and "Rudy" are her favorites.]  

(St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Next week's continuation of Presidential Questions previewed.

The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly (Vice Presidents)
data.segment_description: (St. Louis: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.   (New York: Jeff Greenfield)  The good, the bad and the ugly about American vice presidents presented; scenes shown of John F. Kennedy with Lyndon Johnson, Ronald Reagan with George Bush, Bill Clinton with Al Gore, George W. Bush with Dick Cheney, Richard Nixon with Spiro Agnew, Walter Mondale with Geraldine Ferraro, Bush with Dan Quayle and George McGovern with Tom Eagleton, who was replaced by Sargent Shriver.
